knowledge.title: Knowledge Base Overview
knowledge.importPrompt: Import documents to start using the knowledge base

knowledgeOverview.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeOverview.description: Local LanceDB vector store. Finalized chapters are indexed automatically; you can also import reference files.
knowledgeOverview.vectorlessCount: {{count}} text chunks don't have vector embeddings yet. Upgrade to enable enhanced semantic search.
knowledgeOverview.basicHint: Configure Embedding model to automatically upgrade to hybrid search
knowledgeOverview.searchPlaceholder: Enter query, e.g.: protagonist's power system, worldbuilding core settings...
knowledgeOverview.deleteConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from the knowledge base? Chunks will be deleted; the original file on disk is untouched.
knowledgeOverview.deleteConfirmSetting: “{{name}}” is synced from the setting bible. Saving that module again will re-import it.

reference.noSelection: Select a reference work on the left, or import a source text to start.
reference.digestEmpty: No digests yet. They will appear here after import.

lines.title: Character lines
lines.empty: None yet. Run L0, then confirm candidates.

outline.rerunAllLocked: All lines are locked. Unlock the ones to rerun first.
outline.rerunBusy: Wait for the current analysis to finish
outline.noOutline: Nothing yet. Confirm lines, then build the outline.
outline.needLines: Confirm at least one character line first.

refine.title: Refine by instruction
refine.placeholder: Describe what to change, e.g. merge overly fine stages…
refine.example1: Stages are too fine-grained; merge by major map
refine.example2: Turn the relationship-line rotation section into a table
refine.example3: Keep only foreshadowing that spans 50+ chapters
refine.noScope: Click Refine on a layer or segment on the left first

bookSeed.title: Generate book seed
bookSeed.hint: Borrow this work's stages, character lines and pacing to draft another book from your requirements. Output is files; the current project is untouched.
bookSeed.placeholder: Describe the new book: genre / world / protagonist / chapter count & length / things to keep or avoid…
bookSeed.reuseNamesOff: Off: borrow structure and pacing only; names, places, factions and lore are all replaced.
bookSeed.reuseNamesOn: On: characters from the character lines are kept as-is; only the world / events you name in your requirements change.

digestMode.label: Chapter digests
digestMode.noneHint: Send only L2 / L3, stages and character arcs; smallest input.
digestMode.briefHint: One line per chapter (summary + hook), evenly sampled to 60 chapters; lets you change events by chapter number.
digestMode.fullHint: Every chapter with events, hook and active line; drops to Brief above 60k chars. Slow and costly for hundreds of chapters.

exports.title: Exports
exports.empty: No book seed yet. Use “Generate book seed” in the header.
exports.deleteConfirm: Delete this record? Files on disk are kept.
